why: Ground truth for the log of the same name. See the sibling .expected.json for why these live beside the log rather than in the test file.
covers: the branch where a log holds TWO recordings and nothing names the master, so select_recording must REFUSE rather than pick one - a wrong pick offsets every event by a constant and nothing downstream can detect that
note_on_first_span: The scene in force when recording began was selected at elapsed 20.5s, BEFORE the recording-start line at 30.0s. It must still appear, running from t=0 - OBS logs a switch when it happens, not when recording begins, so dropping it would leave the opening of every stream with no scene at all.
